subset: first 1000 examples in canonical batch order
fft: numpy rfft2 norm=ortho with exact Parseval half-plane weights
radial_bin: floor(sqrt(fx^2 + fy^2)) in unshifted integer-frequency coordinates
channel_aggregation: mean over images, RGB channels, and full-plane sites in each shell
role: dataset-level diagnostic spectrum; not evidence of a causal memorization boundary
